name: Alert
description: You are unusually quick to react when danger starts getting ideas.

name: Crafter
description: You are trained with several artisan tools and can turn practical making into an adventuring advantage.

name: Healer
description: You know how to use a healer's kit to keep companions upright when optimism is no longer medically sufficient.

name: Lucky
description: You gain luck you can spend to bend risky moments in your favor.

name: Magic Initiate (Cleric)
description: Learn two Cleric cantrips and one level 1 Cleric spell.

name: Magic Initiate (Druid)
description: Learn two Druid cantrips and one level 1 Druid spell.

name: Magic Initiate (Wizard)
description: Learn two Wizard cantrips and one level 1 Wizard spell.

name: Musician
description: You are trained with instruments and can inspire allies after rests.

name: Savage Attacker
description: Once per turn, you can make a weapon hit bite harder by rerolling its damage.

name: Skilled
description: Gain proficiency in three skills or tools of your choice.

name: Tavern Brawler
description: Your unarmed strikes and improvised fighting become more dangerous.

name: Tough
description: Your hit point maximum increases by 2 for each character level.
